title: Security Audit Review
summary: Ryan Anderson and Sofia Martinez discussed the database migration timeline. A deadline conflict was identified: the project was originally scoped for within 10 business days, but Ryan Anderson's revised estimate is by year-end. The conflict was not resolved.
notes: CONFLICTING DEADLINES: Database migration deadline stated as 'within 10 business days' early in meeting, then revised to 'by year-end'. Conflict unresolved at end of meeting.
defect_description: The same database migration task has two conflicting deadlines: 'within 10 business days' and 'by year-end'. The AI should flag the conflict rather than arbitrarily picking one.
